description: This Python script demonstrates an example utilizing Speechmatics speech-to-text and text-to-speech services integrated with a pipeline framework. It sets up configurations for speaker diarization, VAD, and TTS, and defines a main asynchronous function to initialize and run the bot with specific transport mechanisms and pipeline components.
